lines.text: Merodach-baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah after hearing about his illness and recovery.
Hezekiah welcomed the envoys gladly and showed them his silver, gold, spices, precious oil, and entire armory.
The prophet Isaiah son of Hosea went to King Hezekiah and asked where the envoys had come from.
Isaiah said everything in the palace would be carried off to Babylon, and some of Hezekiah's soldiers would become eunuchs.
Hezekiah told Isaiah the word of the LORD was good, thinking there would be peace and security in his lifetime.
